newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to sell 30,000/T Dec Cochin naphtha.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to sell 30,000/T Dec Cochin naphtha.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to sell 30,00 tonnes of high aromatic naphtha from Cochin on the west coast lifting December 22-24, industry sources said on Monday.
The tender closes December 12 and is valid until December 13.

In its last naphtha tender, IOC sold 25,000 tonnes of low aromatic naphtha lifting December 15-17 to South Korean Hanwha Chemical Corp at $14.87 per tonne below Japanese spot quotes, on a free-on-board (fob) basis from Vizag on the east coast, industry sources said.
